release_query.session_id: exact opaque 32-character hex session_id from first page

release_response.released: true if this call removed the matching session; false if already released, expired or unknown; HTTP 200 is idempotent
release_response.identity: source, session_id, start_time_ms, through_trade_id and limit echo the validated request; an existing session with mismatched range returns HTTP 409 and remains untouched

query.start_time_ms: required positive signed integer Unix milliseconds, inclusive
query.through_trade_id: required positive unsigned integer; fixed live snapshot final trade ID
query.limit: integer 1..1000, default 1000, identical on all session pages
query.page_token: absent on first request; exact next_page_token on subsequent requests

response_fields.session_id: opaque process-local indexed database view identity; metadata and page fingerprints freeze at first request across live and completed historical SQLite shards
response_fields.start_time_ms: signed integer, exact request range start
response_fields.through_trade_id: unsigned integer, exact immutable request final ID
response_fields.session_ttl_seconds: integer 600 from completed indexed metadata freeze; later pages are bounded database index reads verified against frozen page fingerprints, not temporary full-range files
response_fields.predecessor: trade row or null; only first page; last genuine trade before start, excluded from trades
response_fields.trades: array sorted by original trade_id, inclusive start_time_ms and through_trade_id
response_fields.evidence: per-page complete evidence objects for all referenced rows, including predecessor
response_fields.next_page_token: opaque string or null only on final page
response_fields.complete: true only on final page of entirely verified frozen range including predecessor, consecutive original IDs and exact through ID; partial pages false
response_fields.coverage_verified: whole frozen range is verified; never authorizes partial page installation
response_fields.code: null on valid range; explicit reason on incomplete range/resource failure
response_fields.missing_ranges: array of inclusive original trade ID intervals {from_trade_id,through_trade_id}
response_fields.coverage_first_T: first in-range supplier trade_time_ms integer or null
response_fields.coverage_last_T: last in-range supplier trade_time_ms integer or null
response_fields.failure: on a 503 build failure, failure.reason equals code; bounded capacity/deadline/validation failures retain their exact code, while actual OS I/O failures use disk_full, permission_denied, history_io_timeout, or history_io_or_index_failed with os_error when available and detail
response_fields.archive_health_at_freeze: independent JSONL writer health; never used as a query fallback
response_fields.database_health_at_freeze: live indexed database ingestion progress/failure at freeze plus maximum trade ID across all activated SQLite shards; through_trade_id beyond last indexed ID yields explicit database_write_lag, never an owner-memory or JSONL fallback

trade_fields.trade_id: original Binance BTCUSDT integer ID, not aggregate ID
trade_fields.trade_time_ms: integer supplier T (WS) or time (REST), never receipt
trade_fields.event_time_ms: integer supplier E for WS; null for REST
trade_fields.price: exact supplier decimal string from the SHA-verified original row; SQLite may index a normalized numeric-equivalent value
trade_fields.quantity: exact supplier decimal string from the SHA-verified original row, never split aggregate quantity; SQLite may index a normalized numeric-equivalent value
trade_fields.evidence_ref: SHA256 hex string identifying an evidence entry in the same page
trade_fields.source_row_index: zero-based original JSON array index; zero for singleton WS object

evidence_fields.raw_sha256: SHA256 exact decoded raw_base64 bytes, not rewritten JSON
evidence_fields.raw_base64: standard padded Base64 of complete supplier raw body/frame
evidence_fields.source_epoch: original capture epoch string or null, provenance only; not continuity gate
evidence_fields.received_at: original local reception RFC3339 string or null when not retained; diagnostic only
evidence_fields.acquisition: ws_archive or official_recent_trades; no fabricated backfill
evidence_fields.upstream_url: exact maintained WS URL or recent-trades bootstrap URL

budgets.historical_shard_activation: only after explicit import_complete=1 and overlapping trade identities match live database

http.200: frozen page, possibly complete=false with explicit coverage failure
http.503: history_capacity / session_capacity / history_database_unavailable / history_historical_database_invalid / historical_live_trade_identity_conflict / history_database_query_failed / history_database_changed_during_session / history_deadline / database evidence, conflict or budget error; complete=false, no partial success claim
http.release: DELETE release_route returns 200 released true/false, 400 invalid identity, or 409 matching session_id with mismatched range

lifecycle: Open live WS first, freeze final snapshot trade_id, buffer live independently, then request historical pages.
Never block live reception on database or JSONL IO; no new external feed or official history backfill in this implementation.
Collect all pages with identical session/range, verify every raw association and final complete, then match actual live overlap by trade_id/T/price/quantity/maker.

A repeated first-page GET for a still-valid complete frozen range reuses the same session_id and page zero; it does not consume another session slot. This is a retry convenience, not a substitute for verifying all pages and the live overlap.

After successful validation and installation, or after an explicit decision to abandon the range, DELETE the matching frozen session. Do not release while any required page read/retry is still in flight. If the consumer fails transiently and intends to retry, retain the session_id and page_token until its bounded retry/recovery decision. Release is idempotent and does not delete database rows or permanent JSONL originals.
WS and REST raw hashes need not match for identical trades; original evidence remains distinct.
No requirement for matching old/new live source_epoch. Time ordering and original trade ID continuity are independently checked.
Preserve completed historical window facts across reconnect. Current connection recovery and live freshness remain independent.
Budget, evidence, gap or tail failure never becomes strategy-complete coverage. No aggTrades/Kline fallback or interpolation.

A first request validates indexed rows in live SQLite and any completed historical SQLite shard, deduplicated by original trade ID, and stores only bounded page fingerprints/coverage metadata. Each page is independently read from SQLite and rechecked; a changed row fails closed instead of silently changing a frozen session. No entire-range temporary page copy is created.

Raw JSONL segments remain permanent forensic originals and are never queried by normal business requests. Explicit marketcow-btc-db-migrate import may read them after SHA/identity validation; import success does not certify gap-free historical coverage.
